<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR (three singlets integrating to 3 H, 6 H, and 3 H) and the ¹³C NMR (seven distinct carbons: one carbonyl at ~161 ppm, two sp² carbons at ~144 and ~130 ppm, and four aliphatic methyl carbons), the molecule is best described as an α,β‑unsaturated carbonyl with four methyl groups: one acetyl methyl (≈2.6 ppm) and three other methyls attached to the tetrasubstituted double bond (two equivalent gem‑dimethyls giving the 6 H singlet, and one additional methyl giving the 3 H singlet). This fits the SMILES **CC(=O)C(C)(C)=C(C)C**. 

The SMILES string is:
<final_answer>CC(=O)C(C)(C)=C(C)C</final_answer>
